text:
emily: Pet show-and-tell time! What's the weirdest thing your pet does when you're on a call? Pics or GIFs welcome :dog: :cat: 

rob: My cat, Miso, climbs into my laptop bag and pretends it's a cave. Once blocked my mouse for 20 minutes. No shame. :joy: 

dina: @rob that's cute. My bearded dragon bobs his head whenever I say the word 'snack' in a meeting. He knows the snack vocabulary. :lizard: 

oscar: My dog sings (howls) along to any notification sound. Slack pings = full choir. Neighbors think I'm running a musical. :dog_with_tilted_head: 

emily: here's a terrible photo of my ferret curled around my keyboard https://imgur.com/a/FAKEPETPIC (ferret is dramatic)

rob: hahaha that photo needs a tiny crown added.

dina: also pro tip: if your pet sits on your keyboard, press \`Ctrl+Z\` and pretend it was intentional.

oscar: Peanut-bot: reminder: pets are allowed on camera during all-hands next week :robot_face: 

peanut-bot: Announcement: "Bring Your Pet" segment scheduled for Friday's all-hands at 10:15am PST. Submit photos to #watercooler-pets. :bell:

emily: excited. also curious if anyone's pet has a hidden talent?

rob: Miso can push a tiny ball into my slipper on command. I'm training him for slipper retrieval Olympics.

dina: my dragon does a very precise head tilt that could convince anyone he understands quantum mechanics.

oscar: my dog can target the garbage can from three feet away and miss it every time. special skill.

emily: lovely. ok those of us remote with shy pets can submit a 10s clip, bonus points for costumes. :tada: 

rob: costume suggestions: tiny firewall, mini redwood inference logo (handmade), or 'sleepy dev' with a miniature hoodie.

emily: vote: 1) costumes allowed 2) no costumes 3) pets-only (no props). react with :one:, :two:, :three:.

dina: :one: (costumes)

oscar: :three: (pets-only) but ok with costumes if they're small.

peanut-bot: Poll created: "Pet segment rules" — voting open until Thursday 5pm PST.

emily: thanks y'all. looking forward to the chaos. this thread made my afternoon :heart:
